title: probe
description: Frontmatter of a probe record: the record of an independent review that `gov close` reads for a FULL-profile ticket (DEC-137, DEC-487, DEC-490, DEC-565). It is the one record schema that does not require the shared frontmatter's `id`, `status` and `state_class`. The schema says what a well-formed record is; whether a probe lets a ticket close (who reviewed, who judged, what the judgement was) is asked by the probe gate, not here.

judgement.description: The four words DEC-490 names. A record of a failed probe is a well-formed record.
